CEREMONIALBEAST-STRIKE.title: Strike

CEREMONIALBEAST-CEREMONIAL_STOMP.title: Stomp
CEREMONIALBEAST-PLOWING.title: Plowing
CEREMONIALBEAST-PLOWING.description: Choose {Cards:diff()} card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] to [gold]enchant[/gold] with [purple]Cultivate[/purple].
CEREMONIALBEAST-BRUTAL_BUMP.title: Brutal Bump
CEREMONIALBEAST-BRUTAL_BUMP.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
If you have [gold]Strength[/gold], increase this card's damage to {EnhancedDamage:diff()}.
CEREMONIALBEAST-CRUSH.title: Crush
CEREMONIALBEAST-TRAMPLE.title: Trample
CEREMONIALBEAST-REVERBERANCE.title: Reverberance
CEREMONIALBEAST-REVERBERANCE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
The next card with [gold]Ringing[/gold] you play costs [blue]0[/blue].
CEREMONIALBEAST-DANCE_OF_DEATH.title: Dance of Death
CEREMONIALBEAST-DANCE_OF_DEATH.descripti:
Take half damage from enemies this turn.
At the start of your next turn, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
[gold]Ringing[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-BONE_BREAKER.title: Bone Breaker
CEREMONIALBEAST-TAIL_SWING.title: Tail Swing
CEREMONIALBEAST-TAIL_SWING.description: This turn, whenever you attack an enemy, apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to it.
CEREMONIALBEAST-CEREMONIAL_PLOWING.title: Sacrificial Stone
CEREMONIALBEAST-THICK_FUR.title: Thick Fur
CEREMONIALBEAST-DIGGING.title: Digging
CEREMONIALBEAST-STAMPEDE.title: Stampede
CEREMONIALBEAST-STAMPEDE.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
For each Attack drawn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
CEREMONIALBEAST-FINAL_CEREMONY.title: Final Ceremony
CEREMONIALBEAST-FINAL_CEREMONY.descripti:
Lose half your current HP.
Gain [gold]Plow[/gold] equal to the HP lost.
[gold]Ringing[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-PAIN_REVERSAL.title: Pain Reversal
CEREMONIALBEAST-PAIN_REVERSAL.descriptio:
Enemy loses HP equal to your missing HP.{IsTargeting:
(Loses [blue]{LostHp:diff()}[/blue] HP)|}
CEREMONIALBEAST-TERRITORIAL.title: Territorial
CEREMONIALBEAST-TERRITORIAL.description: Whenever you lose HP, draw {Cards:diff()} card.
CEREMONIALBEAST-TENACITY.title: Tenacity
CEREMONIALBEAST-TENACITY.description: At the end of your turn, if you have less than half HP, gain {BlockValue:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-SOUL_OF_WHITE_STAG.title: Soul of White Stag
CEREMONIALBEAST-SOUL_OF_WHITE_STAG.descr: Healing is [blue]{HealBonus:diff()}%[/blue] more effective in combat.
CEREMONIALBEAST-BERSERKER_STANCE.title: Berserker Stance
CEREMONIALBEAST-BERSERKER_STANCE.descrip: If you have less than half HP, deal [blue]{DamageBonus:diff()}%[/blue] more damage.
CEREMONIALBEAST-FLURRY_OF_HOOVES.title: Flurry of Hooves
CEREMONIALBEAST-RESOLUTE_ASSAULT.title: Resolute Assault
CEREMONIALBEAST-DEVOUR.title: Devour
CEREMONIALBEAST-WOUNDED_POUNCE.title: Wounded Pounce
CEREMONIALBEAST-WOUNDED_POUNCE.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you have 50% HP or less, attack {IfUpgraded:show:3|2} times.
CEREMONIALBEAST-SWIFT_HOOVES.title: Swift Hooves
CEREMONIALBEAST-SWIFT_HOOVES.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Next turn, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and draw {Cards:diff()} card.
CEREMONIALBEAST-HOARD.title: Hoard
CEREMONIALBEAST-HOARD.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
At the end of this turn, [gold]Retain[/gold] up to {RetainAmount:diff()} cards.
CEREMONIALBEAST-EARTHSHATTER.title: Earthshatter
CEREMONIALBEAST-EARTHSHATTER.description:
Can only be played while you have [gold]Ringing[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies {Repeat:diff()} times.
CEREMONIALBEAST-ARMOR_PIERCE.title: Armor Pierce
CEREMONIALBEAST-ARMOR_PIERCE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you have at least [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Plow[/gold], apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-ANTLER_TOSS.title: Antler Toss
CEREMONIALBEAST-WILD_SURGE.title: Wild Surge
CEREMONIALBEAST-WILD_SURGE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn equal to your [gold]Plow[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-BEAST_INSTINCT.title: Beast Instinct
CEREMONIALBEAST-BEAST_INSTINCT.descripti:
When drawn, automatically play this card.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
[gold]Ringing[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-FORAGE.title: Forage
CEREMONIALBEAST-FORAGE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you have no more than {CardCount:diff()} cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold], draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
CEREMONIALBEAST-RINGING_ECHO.title: Ringing Echo
CEREMONIALBEAST-RINGING_ECHO.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage once for each time you entered [gold]Ringing[/gold] this combat.{InCombat:
(Hits {CalculatedHits:diff()} {CalculatedHits:plural:time|times})|}
CEREMONIALBEAST-VENT.title: Vent
CEREMONIALBEAST-VENT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you have at least {PlowCost:diff()} [gold]Plow[/gold], lose {PlowCost:diff()} [gold]Plow[/gold] and deal damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
CEREMONIALBEAST-CLAW_FLURRY.title: Gravel Shot
CEREMONIALBEAST-APOCALYPSE.title: Apocalypse
CEREMONIALBEAST-OVERGROWTH_WRATH.title: Overgrowth Wrath
CEREMONIALBEAST-ANTLER_PARRY.title: Antler Parry
CEREMONIALBEAST-SURVIVAL_INSTINCT.title: Survival Instinct
CEREMONIALBEAST-SURVIVAL_INSTINCT.descri:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If you have 50% HP or less, increase this card's Block to {IfUpgraded:show:16|12}.
CEREMONIALBEAST-HOLD_BREATH.title: Hold Breath
CEREMONIALBEAST-HOLD_BREATH.description:
If you have [gold]Ringing[/gold], [gold]Retain[/gold] your [gold]Hand[/gold] this turn.
Otherwise, enter [gold]Ringing[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-RAIN_DANCE.title: Rain Dance
CEREMONIALBEAST-RAIN_DANCE.description: Next turn, gain {StrengthPower:diff()} temporary [gold]Strength[/gold] and {DexterityPower:diff()} temporary [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-RUNIC_REVELATION.title: Runic Revelation
CEREMONIALBEAST-RUNIC_REVELATION.descrip:
Draw {Cards:diff()} card.
[gold]Enchant[/gold] {IfUpgraded:show:ALL cards|1 card} in your [gold]Hand[/gold] with [purple]Inspire[/purple].
[gold]Ringing[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-FATAL_LOCK.title: Fatal Lock
CEREMONIALBEAST-FATAL_LOCK.description:
Your next Attack deals [blue]{FatalLockPower:diff()}%[/blue] additional damage.
[gold]Ringing[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-CEREMONIAL_PREP.title: Ceremonial Prep
CEREMONIALBEAST-CEREMONIAL_PREP.descript: The next {Plays:diff()} cards you play cost {Discount:diff()} less.
CEREMONIALBEAST-BESTIAL_PRESENCE.title: Bestial Presence
CEREMONIALBEAST-ANCIENT_AEGIS.title: Ancient Aegis
CEREMONIALBEAST-ANCIENT_AEGIS.descriptio:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Reduce this card's cost by [blue]1[/blue] this combat.
CEREMONIALBEAST-OVERGROWTH_MEMORY.title: Overgrowth Memory
CEREMONIALBEAST-OVERGROWTH_MEMORY.descri: Put {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-OVERGROWTH_MEMORY.select: Choose a card to put into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-ENDURE_PAIN.title: Endure Pain
CEREMONIALBEAST-ENDURE_PAIN.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
This turn, whenever you are attacked, gain {PlowAmount:diff()} [gold]Plow[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-RITUAL_DANCE.title: Ritual Dance
CEREMONIALBEAST-RITUAL_DANCE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If this is the first card you played this turn, gain {ExtraBlock:diff()} additional [gold]Block[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-DETERRENCE.title: Deterrence
CEREMONIALBEAST-DETERRENCE.description: At the end of your turn, if you have no [gold]Block[/gold], ALL enemies lose {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-HARVEST.title: Harvest
CEREMONIALBEAST-HARVEST.description:
Gain [gold]Plow[/gold] equal to the number of cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].{IsTargeting:
(Gain [blue]{PlowAmount:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Plow[/gold])|}
CEREMONIALBEAST-RESOUNDING_ECHO.title: Resounding Echo
CEREMONIALBEAST-RESOUNDING_ECHO.descript: Whenever you enter [gold]Ringing[/gold], deal {ResoundingEchoPower:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
CEREMONIALBEAST-FERTILE_GROUND.title: Fertile Ground
CEREMONIALBEAST-TILLER_SHIELD.title: Tiller Shield
CEREMONIALBEAST-PAIN_RESONANCE.title: Pain Resonance
CEREMONIALBEAST-PAIN_RESONANCE.descripti: Whenever you lose HP, deal {PainResonancePower:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
CEREMONIALBEAST-ADAPTIVE_BODY.title: Adaptive Body
CEREMONIALBEAST-ADAPTIVE_BODY.descriptio: You no longer lose temporary [gold]Dexterity[/gold] or [gold]Strength[/gold] from [gold]Plow[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-BEHEMOTH_PHYSIQUE.title: Behemoth Physique
CEREMONIALBEAST-BEHEMOTH_PHYSIQUE.descri: Whenever you lose HP, reduce the HP lost by {ReductionAmount:diff()}.
CEREMONIALBEAST-RUINING_DOOM_HORN.title: Ruining Doom Horn
CEREMONIALBEAST-WALLOW.title: Wallow
CEREMONIALBEAST-VENGEFUL_COUNTER.title: Vengeful Counter
CEREMONIALBEAST-VENGEFUL_COUNTER.descrip:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you took damage last turn, this card costs [blue]0[/blue] this turn.
CEREMONIALBEAST-SIPHONING_BITE.title: Shield Tackle
CEREMONIALBEAST-SIPHONING_BITE.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the total unblocked damage dealt.
[gold]Ringing[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-SAVAGE_MAJESTY.title: Savage Majesty
CEREMONIALBEAST-SAVAGE_MAJESTY.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] and {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.
[gold]Ringing[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-RAMPAGE.title: Rampage
CEREMONIALBEAST-RAMPAGE.description:
Can only be played while you have [gold]Ringing[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Gain {PlowPower:diff()} [gold]Plow[/gold] and {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-EARTHEN_SHIELD.title: Earthen Shield
CEREMONIALBEAST-DESPERATE_REVIVAL.title: Desperate Revival
CEREMONIALBEAST-DESPERATE_REVIVAL.descri:
Can only be played if you have 50% HP or less.
Gain {RegenPower:diff()} [gold]Regen[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-NOPE.title: Soberize
CEREMONIALBEAST-SILENCE.title: Silence
CEREMONIALBEAST-BREAKING_CHAINS.title: Breaking Chains
CEREMONIALBEAST-BREAKING_CHAINS.descript: At the start of your turn, add 1 [gold]Soberize[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-TILLING_STRIKE.title: Tilling Strike
CEREMONIALBEAST-TILLING_STRIKE.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add 1 [gold]Sacrificial Stone[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Shuffle this card into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-STAMP.title: Stamp
CEREMONIALBEAST-STAMP.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Add 1 [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Rampage+|Rampage}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-TOUGH_ROOTS.title: Tough Roots
CEREMONIALBEAST-TOUGH_ROOTS.description:
At the end of your turn, if you have [gold]Ringing[/gold], next turn gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and draw {Cards:diff()} card.
[gold]Ringing[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-HARVEST_FESTIVAL.title: Harvest Festival
CEREMONIALBEAST-HARVEST_FESTIVAL.descrip:
Shuffle [blue]{IfUpgraded:show:X+1|X}[/blue] [gold]Ceremonial Plowing[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
Next turn, draw [blue]{IfUpgraded:show:X+1|X}[/blue] cards.
CEREMONIALBEAST-PROFANE_RITUAL.title: Profane Ritual
CEREMONIALBEAST-PROFANE_RITUAL.descripti: You can play cards while you have [gold]Ringing[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-CEREMONIAL_FORM.title: Ceremonial Form
CEREMONIALBEAST-CEREMONIAL_FORM.descript: At the start of your turn, enter [gold]Ringing[/gold] and add 1 [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Rampage+|Rampage}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-BEAST_GRACE.title: Beast Grace
CEREMONIALBEAST-BEAST_GRACE.description:
Can only be played while you have [gold]Ringing[/gold].
[gold]Stun[/gold] ALL enemies.
CEREMONIALBEAST-SACRIFICIAL_SURGE.title: Sacrificial Surge
CEREMONIALBEAST-SACRIFICIAL_SURGE.descri:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
After the next card you play this turn, force yourself into [gold]Ringing[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-CONCUSSIVE_BLOW.title: Concussive Blow
CEREMONIALBEAST-CONCUSSIVE_BLOW.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If this deals at least [blue]30[/blue] unblocked damage, [gold]Stun[/gold] the enemy.
CEREMONIALBEAST-BEAST_CRY.title: Beast Cry
CEREMONIALBEAST-ESCALATING_FRENZY.title: Escalating Frenzy
CEREMONIALBEAST-ESCALATING_FRENZY.descri:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
After the next card you play this turn, enter [gold]Ringing[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-GIGANTIFICATION.title: Gigantification
CEREMONIALBEAST-GIGANTIFICATION.descript: Double your current HP and Max HP for this combat.
CEREMONIALBEAST-RITUAL_RECALL.title: Ritual Recall
CEREMONIALBEAST-RITUAL_RECALL.descriptio:
Can only be played while you have [gold]Ringing[/gold].
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Remove your [gold]Ringing[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-RITUAL_RECALL_PROMPT: Choose a card to put into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-QUIETUDE.title: Quietude
CEREMONIALBEAST-QUIETUDE.description: At the end of your turn, heal {QuietudePower:diff()} HP for each unspent Energy.
CEREMONIALBEAST-BLOOD_SACRIFICE.title: Blood Sacrifice
CEREMONIALBEAST-BLOOD_SACRIFICE.descript:
Choose {Cards:diff()} cards in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] to [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
CEREMONIALBEAST-ANCIENT_BLESSING.title: Ancient Blessing
CEREMONIALBEAST-ANCIENT_BLESSING.descrip: At the start of your turn, choose 1 card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] to [gold]enchant[/gold] with [purple]Blessing[/purple] for this combat.
CEREMONIALBEAST-CEREMONIAL_HARVEST.title: Ceremonial Harvest
CEREMONIALBEAST-CEREMONIAL_HARVEST.descr:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Fatal[/gold]: Permanently [gold]enchant[/gold] 1 random card in your deck with [purple]Accumulate[/purple].
CEREMONIALBEAST-DARK_REVELATION.title: Dark Revelation
CEREMONIALBEAST-DARK_REVELATION.descript: At the start of your turn, randomly [gold]enchant[/gold] {DarkRevelationPower:diff()} unenchanted Attack in your [gold]Hand[/gold] with [purple]Corruption[/purple] for this combat.
CEREMONIALBEAST-BLESSED_HARVEST.title: Blessed Harvest
CEREMONIALBEAST-BLESSED_HARVEST.descript: Whenever you draw an [gold]enchanted[/gold] card, draw {BlessedHarvestPower:diff()} card.
CEREMONIALBEAST-ENCHANTED_DETERRENCE.des: Whenever you play an [gold]enchanted[/gold] card, ALL enemies lose {EnchantedDeterrencePower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
CEREMONIALBEAST-SHARED_FURROW.title: Shared Furrow
CEREMONIALBEAST-RITUAL_RELAY.title: Ritual Relay
CEREMONIALBEAST-RITUAL_RELAY.description:
Another player's next card is played {PlayCount:diff()} times. Then they gain [gold]Ringing[/gold].
[gold]Ringing[/gold].
